name: FrogDrawer
description: Adaptive contextual overlay presented as a modal bottom sheet or docked side panel without navigating away from the current screen destination.

accessibility.talkBackNotes: Declares paneTitle semantics for window transition announcement, trapped focus, and provides accessible 48dp dismiss targets and back navigation.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Controls drawer visibility, current value, target value, and programmatic open/close suspend operations.

properties.name: onDismissRequest
properties.description: Callback invoked when the drawer is dismissed via scrim tap, back press, or drag-to-dismiss gesture.

properties.name: modifier
properties.description: Layout modifier applied to the drawer container.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description: Presentation mode: Auto adapts to screen width (<620dp bottom, >=620dp side), Bottom presents as bottom sheet, Side presents as docked edge panel.

properties.name: side
properties.description: Docking edge for side presentation mode (Start or End).

properties.name: title
properties.description: Title text rendered in the header with heading accessibility semantics.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Subtitle text rendered underneath the title.

properties.name: navigationIcon
properties.description: Optional slot rendered at the start of the header, typically a back navigation action.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Optional trailing actions slot rendered in the header before the close button.

properties.name: preview
properties.description: Optional live preview slot rendered directly below the header divider.

properties.name: footer
properties.description: Optional sticky footer slot anchored below the scrollable content area.

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Resolved colors for container, content, border, handle, and scrim.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The scrollable content body rendered within the drawer.

examples.title: Basic Drawer
examples.description: Simple open and close with hoisted state.

examples.title: Bottom Presentation
examples.description: Compact modal bottom sheet with drag handle.

examples.title: Custom Header Actions
examples.description: Header with navigation and secondary reset action.

examples.title: Sticky Action Footer
examples.description: Sticky Cancel and Apply buttons below scroll body.

examples.title: Scrollable Content Body
examples.description: Long form content testing scroll containment.
